source_arguments.source_statement:
theorem finiteBoundaryOneEnded_boxProd
    {W : Type*} [Infinite V] [Infinite W]
    (G : SimpleGraph V) (H : SimpleGraph W)
    (hG : G.Preconnected) (hH : H.Preconnected) :
    FiniteBoundaryOneEnded (G □ H)
source_arguments.proof_excerpt:
by
  intro A hboundary
  let SG : Set V := edgeFirstCoordinateSupport (edgeBoundary (G □ H) A)
  let SH : Set W := edgeSecondCoordinateSupport (edgeBoundary (G □ H) A)
  have hSG : SG.Finite := by
    dsimp [SG]
    exact edgeFirstCoordinateSupport_finite hboundary
  have hSH : SH.Finite := by
    dsimp [SH]
    exact edgeSecondCoordinateSupport_finite hboundary
  obtain ⟨g₀, hg₀⟩ := exists_not_mem_of_finite hSG
  obtain ⟨h₀, hh₀⟩ := exists_not_mem_of_finite hSH
  have hright : ∀ g ∉ SG, ∀ h₁ h₂ : W,
      cutLabel A (g, h₁) = cutLabel A (g, h₂) := by
    intro g hg h₁ h₂
    apply eq_of_preconnected_of_adjInvariant hH (fun h => cutLabel A (g, h))
    exact cutLabel_adjInvariant_right_of_not_mem_firstSupport A g (by
      simpa only [SG] using hg)
  have hleft : ∀ h ∉ SH, ∀ g₁ g₂ : V,
      cutLabel A (g₁, h) = cutLabel A (g₂, h) := by
    intro h hh g₁ g₂
    apply eq_of_preconnected_of_adjInvariant hG (fun g => cutLabel A (g, h))
    exact cutLabel_adjInvariant_left_of_not_mem_secondSupport A h (by
      simpa only [SH] using hh)
  have houtside : ∀ x : V × W, x ∉ SG ×ˢ SH →
      cutLabel A x = cutLabel A (g₀, h₀) := by
    intro x hx
    rcases x with ⟨g, h⟩
    by_cases hg : g ∈ SG
    · have hh : h ∉ SH := by
        intro hh
        exact hx ⟨hg, hh⟩
      exact (hleft h hh g g₀).trans (hright g₀ hg₀ h h₀)
    · exact (hright g hg h h₀).trans (hleft h₀ hh₀ g g₀)
  have hrectangle : (SG ×ˢ SH).Finite := hSG.prod hSH
  by_cases hbase : (g₀, h₀) ∈ A
  · right
    apply hrectangle.subset
    intro x hx
    change x ∉ A at hx
    by_contra hxrectangle
    have hlabel := houtside x hxrectangle
    rw [cutLabel_eq_iff] at hlabel
    exact hx (hlabel.mpr hbase)
  · left
    apply hrectangle.subset
    intro x hx
    by_contra hxrectangle
    have hlabel := houtside x hxrectangle
    rw [cutLabel_eq_iff] at hlabel
    exact hbase (hlabel.mp hx)

import Mathlib.Combinatorics.SimpleGraph.Connectivity.Connected
import Mathlib.Combinatorics.SimpleGraph.Prod
import Mathlib.Data.Set.Finite.Lattice

/-!
# Coherence-end reconstruction

Finite-defect pair coherence recovers a projective Boolean or finite-clock vertex tail exactly
under the finite-boundary one-ended condition.  Cartesian products of two infinite preconnected
graphs satisfy that condition, yielding a rigorous tensor-stabilization law.
-/

namespace GaloisForLFunctions.HTGeometry

open Set

universe u

variable {V : Type u}

/-- Ordered edges crossing the cut determined by `A`. -/
def edgeBoundary (G : SimpleGraph V) (A : Set V) : Set (V × V) :=
  {e | G.Adj e.1 e.2 ∧
    ((e.1 ∈ A ∧ e.2 ∉ A) ∨ (e.1 ∉ A ∧ e.2 ∈ A))}

/-- The Boolean pair coherence displayed on an ordered pair. -/
def booleanEdgeCoherence (ε : V → Bool) (e : V × V) : Bool :=
  Bool.xor (ε e.1) (ε e.2)

/-- Ordered graph edges on which two Boolean coherence fields disagree. -/
def booleanEdgeDisagreement (G : SimpleGraph V) (ε δ : V → Bool) : Set (V × V) :=
  {e | G.Adj e.1 e.2 ∧ booleanEdgeCoherence ε e ≠ booleanEdgeCoherence δ e}

/-- **Domain-wall identity.**  Two Boolean pair-coherence fields disagree exactly on the
edge boundary of the set on which the vertex orientations disagree. -/
theorem booleanEdgeDisagreement_eq_edgeBoundary
    (G : SimpleGraph V) (ε δ : V → Bool) :
    booleanEdgeDisagreement G ε δ = edgeBoundary G {v | ε v ≠ δ v} := by
  ext e
  cases hε₁ : ε e.1 <;> cases hδ₁ : δ e.1 <;>
    cases hε₂ : ε e.2 <;> cases hδ₂ : δ e.2 <;>
    simp [booleanEdgeDisagreement, booleanEdgeCoherence, edgeBoundary,
      hε₁, hδ₁, hε₂, hδ₂]

/-- The exact finite-boundary form of one-endedness needed by coherence reconstruction. -/
def FiniteBoundaryOneEnded (G : SimpleGraph V) : Prop :=
  ∀ A : Set V, (edgeBoundary G A).Finite → A.Finite ∨ Aᶜ.Finite

/-- Equality of Boolean orientations outside a finite vertex set, up to one global complement. -/
def BooleanProjectiveFiniteEquivalent (ε δ : V → Bool) : Prop :=
  {v | ε v ≠ δ v}.Finite ∨ {v | ε v = δ v}.Finite

/-- Equality of Boolean pair-coherence fields outside a finite ordered-edge set. -/
def BooleanEdgeTailEquivalent (G : SimpleGraph V) (ε δ : V → Bool) : Prop :=
  (booleanEdgeDisagreement G ε δ).Finite

theorem complement_disagreementSet (ε δ : V → Bool) :
    {v | ε v ≠ δ v}ᶜ = {v | ε v = δ v} := by
  ext v
  simp

/-- Finite-boundary one-endedness is exactly faithfulness of finite-defect Boolean edge
coherence on projective vertex tails. -/
theorem finiteBoundaryOneEnded_iff_booleanEdgeTail_faithful (G : SimpleGraph V) :
    FiniteBoundaryOneEnded G ↔
      ∀ ε δ : V → Bool,
        BooleanEdgeTailEquivalent G ε δ → BooleanProjectiveFiniteEquivalent ε δ := by
  constructor
  · intro hG ε δ hedge
    rw [BooleanEdgeTailEquivalent, booleanEdgeDisagreement_eq_edgeBoundary] at hedge
    rcases hG {v | ε v ≠ δ v} hedge with hfinite | hcofinite
    · exact Or.inl hfinite
    · exact Or.inr (by simpa only [complement_disagreementSet] using hcofinite)
  · intro hfaithful A hboundary
    classical
    let ε : V → Bool := fun v => if v ∈ A then true else false
    let δ : V → Bool := fun _ => false
    have hdisagreement : {v | ε v ≠ δ v} = A := by
      ext v
      simp [ε, δ]
    have hagreement : {v | ε v = δ v} = Aᶜ := by
      ext v
      simp [ε, δ]
    have hedge : BooleanEdgeTailEquivalent G ε δ := by
      rw [BooleanEdgeTailEquivalent, booleanEdgeDisagreement_eq_edgeBoundary,
        hdisagreement]
      exact hboundary
    rcases hfaithful ε δ hedge with h | h
    · exact Or.inl (by simpa only [hdisagreement] using h)
    · exact Or.inr (by simpa only [hagreement] using h)

/-- An edge-invariant vertex label is constant on a preconnected graph. -/
theorem eq_of_preconnected_of_adjInvariant {α : Type*} {G : SimpleGraph V}
    (hG : G.Preconnected) (f : V → α)
    (hf : ∀ ⦃u v⦄, G.Adj u v → f u = f v) (u v : V) :
    f u = f v := by
  have huv := hG u v
  rw [SimpleGraph.reachable_iff_reflTransGen] at huv
  induction huv with
  | refl => rfl
  | tail _ hxy ih => exact ih.trans (hf hxy)

/-- Exact Boolean edge coherence on a preconnected graph determines the orientation up to one
global complement. -/
theorem booleanEdgeCoherence_eq_projective_of_preconnected
    {G : SimpleGraph V} (hG : G.Preconnected) (ε δ : V → Bool)
    (hcoh : ∀ ⦃u v⦄, G.Adj u v →
      Bool.xor (ε u) (ε v) = Bool.xor (δ u) (δ v)) :
    ε = δ ∨ ε = fun v => !(δ v) := by
  let relative : V → Bool := fun v => Bool.xor (ε v) (δ v)
  have hinvariant : ∀ ⦃u v⦄, G.Adj u v → relative u = relative v := by
    intro u v huv
    specialize hcoh huv
    cases hεu : ε u <;> cases hδu : δ u <;>
      cases hεv : ε v <;> cases hδv : δ v <;>
      simp_all [relative]
  cases isEmpty_or_nonempty V with
  | inl hempty =>
      left
      funext v
      exact isEmptyElim v
  | inr hnonempty =>
      let v₀ : V := Classical.choice hnonempty
      have hconstant : ∀ v, relative v = relative v₀ :=

j, hne⟩
  by_cases hεδpoint : booleanEdgeCoherence ε e = booleanEdgeCoherence δ e
  · right
    exact ⟨hadj, fun hδηpoint => hne (hεδpoint.trans hδηpoint)⟩
  · left
    exact ⟨hadj, hεδpoint⟩

def booleanEdgeTailSetoid (G : SimpleGraph V) : Setoid (V → Bool) where
  r := BooleanEdgeTailEquivalent G
  iseqv := ⟨BooleanEdgeTailEquivalent.refl G,
    BooleanEdgeTailEquivalent.symm,
    BooleanEdgeTailEquivalent.trans⟩

theorem booleanProjectiveFiniteEquivalent_implies_edgeTail
    (G : SimpleGraph V) [G.LocallyFinite] {ε δ : V → Bool}
    (h : BooleanProjectiveFiniteEquivalent ε δ) :
    BooleanEdgeTailEquivalent G ε δ := by
  rw [BooleanEdgeTailEquivalent, booleanEdgeDisagreement_eq_edgeBoundary]
  rcases h with h | h
  · exact edgeBoundary_finite_of_set_finite G h
  · have hcompl : {v | ε v ≠ δ v}ᶜ = {v | ε v = δ v} :=
      complement_disagreementSet ε δ
    have hfinite : ({v | ε v ≠ δ v}ᶜ).Finite := by
      simpa only [hcompl] using h
    rw [← edgeBoundary_compl G {v | ε v ≠ δ v}]
    exact edgeBoundary_finite_of_set_finite G hfinite

/-- Projective Boolean vertex tails modulo finite changes and global complement. -/
def BooleanProjectiveFiniteTail (V : Type u) := Quotient (@booleanProjectiveFiniteSetoid V)

/-- Boolean coherence fields modulo finitely many defective ordered graph edges. -/
def BooleanEdgeCoherenceTail (G : SimpleGraph V) := Quotient (booleanEdgeTailSetoid G)

def booleanProjectiveFiniteTailClass (ε : V → Bool) : BooleanProjectiveFiniteTail V :=
  Quotient.mk _ ε

def booleanEdgeCoherenceTailClass (G : SimpleGraph V) (ε : V → Bool) :
    BooleanEdgeCoherenceTail G :=
  Quotient.mk _ ε

/-- The canonical finite-defect coherence readout from projective vertex tails. -/
def coherenceTailMap (G : SimpleGraph V) [G.LocallyFinite] :
    BooleanProjectiveFiniteTail V → BooleanEdgeCoherenceTail G :=
  Quotient.map id fun _ _ h => booleanProjectiveFiniteEquivalent_implies_edgeTail G h

@[simp] theorem coherenceTailMap_class (G : SimpleGraph V) [G.LocallyFinite]
    (ε : V → Bool) :
    coherenceTailMap G (booleanProjectiveFiniteTailClass ε) =
      booleanEdgeCoherenceTailClass G ε := rfl

/-- Equality of two canonical readouts is exactly finiteness of the domain wall between the two
vertex orientations.  This is the formal kernel formula before any topological presentation by
the end space. -/
theorem coherenceTailMap_class_eq_iff_finite_edgeBoundary
    (G : SimpleGraph V) [G.LocallyFinite] (ε δ : V → Bool) :
    coherenceTailMap G (booleanProjectiveFiniteTailClass ε) =
        coherenceTailMap G (booleanProjectiveFiniteTailClass δ) ↔
      (edgeBoundary G {v | ε v ≠ δ v}).Finite := by
  rw [coherenceTailMap_class, coherenceTailMap_class]
  constructor
  · intro h
    have htail : BooleanEdgeTailEquivalent G ε δ := Quotient.exact h
    rwa [BooleanEdgeTailEquivalent, booleanEdgeDisagreement_eq_edgeBoundary] at htail
  · intro h
    apply Quotient.sound
    change BooleanEdgeTailEquivalent G ε δ
    rwa [BooleanEdgeTailEquivalent, booleanEdgeDisagreement_eq_edgeBoundary]

/-- Kernel at the all-positive orientation: a Boolean phase is invisible to finite-defect edge
coherence exactly when its negative domain has finite edge boundary. -/
theorem coherenceTailMap_eq_allPositive_iff_negativeDomain_finiteBoundary
    (G : SimpleGraph V) [G.LocallyFinite] (ε : V → Bool) :
    coherenceTailMap G (booleanProjectiveFiniteTailClass ε) =
        coherenceTailMap G (booleanProjectiveFiniteTailClass (fun _ => false)) ↔
      (edgeBoundary G {v | ε v = true}).Finite := by
  rw [coherenceTailMap_class_eq_iff_finite_edgeBoundary]

/-- **Tensor stabilization.**  The Cartesian product of two infinite preconnected graphs has the
finite-boundary one-ended property.  Thus every finite-valued relative phase with finitely many
defective product-edge coherences is eventually constant. -/
theorem finiteBoundaryOneEnded_boxProd
    {W : Type*} [Infinite V] [Infinite W]
    (G : SimpleGraph V) (H : SimpleGraph W)
    (hG : G.Preconnected) (hH : H.Preconnected) :
    FiniteBoundaryOneEnded (G □ H) := by
  intro A hboundary
  let SG : Set V := edgeFirstCoordinateSupport (edgeBoundary (G □ H) A)
  let SH : Set W := edgeSecondCoordinateSupport (edgeBoundary (G □ H) A)
  have hSG : SG.Finite := by
    dsimp [SG]
    exact edgeFirstCoordinateSupport_finite hboundary
  have hSH : SH.Finite := by
    dsimp [SH]
    exact edgeSecondCoordinateSupport_finite hboundary
  obtain ⟨g₀, hg₀⟩ := exists_not_mem_of_finite hSG
  obtain ⟨h₀, hh₀⟩ := exists_not_mem_of_finite hSH
  have hright : ∀ g ∉ SG, ∀ h₁ h₂ : W,
      cutLabel A (g, h₁) = cutLabel A (g, h₂) := by
    intro g hg h₁ h₂
    apply eq_of_preconnected_of_adjInvariant hH (fun h => cutLabel A (g, h))
    exact cutLabel_adjInvariant_right_of_not_mem_firstSupport A g (by
      simpa only [SG] using hg)
  have hleft : ∀ h ∉ SH, ∀ g₁ g₂ : V,
      cutLabel A (g₁, h) = cutLabel A (g₂, h) := by
    intro h hh g₁ g₂
    apply eq_of_preconnected_of_adjInvariant hG (fun g => cutLabel A (g, h))
    exact cutLabel_adjInvariant_left_of_not_mem_secondSupport A h (by
      simpa only [SH] using hh)
  have houtside : ∀ x : V × W, x ∉ SG ×ˢ SH →
      cutLabel A x = cutLabel A (g₀, h₀) := by
    intro x hx
    rcases x with ⟨g, h⟩
    by_cases hg : g ∈ SG
    · have hh : h ∉ SH := by
        intro hh
        exact hx ⟨hg, hh⟩
      exact (hleft h hh g g₀).trans (hright g₀ hg₀ h h₀)
    · exact (hright g hg h h₀).trans (hleft h₀ hh₀ g g₀)
  have hrectangle : (SG ×ˢ SH).Finite := hSG.prod hSH
  by_cases hbase : (g₀, h₀) ∈ A
  · right
    apply hrectangle.subset
    intro x hx
    change x ∉ A at hx
    by_contra hxrectangle
    have hlabel := houtside x hxrectangle
    rw [cutLabel_eq_iff] at hlabel
    exact hx (hlabel.mpr hbase)
  · left
    apply hrectangle.subset
    intro x hx
    by_contra hxrectangle
    have hlabel := houtside x hxrectangle
    rw [cutLabel_eq_iff] at hlabel
    exact hbase (hlabel.mp hx)

/-- Ordered graph edges across which a vertex label changes. -/
def edgeVariation {α : Type*} (G : SimpleGraph V) (f : V → α) : Set (V × V) :=
  {e | G.Adj e.1 e.2 ∧ f e.1 ≠ f e.2}

/-- A finite-valued label has a projective tail when it is constant away from finitely many
vertices. -/
def EventuallyConstant {α : Type*} (f : V → α) : Prop :=
  ∃ a, {v | f v ≠ a}.Finite

theorem edgeBoundary_fiber_subset_edgeVariation {α : Type*}
    (G : SimpleGraph V) (f : V → α) (a : α) :
    edgeBoundary G {v | f v = a} ⊆ edgeVariation G f := by
  intro e he
  rcases he with ⟨hadj, hcross | hcross⟩
  · refine ⟨hadj, fun heq => hcross.2 ?_⟩
    change f e.1 = a ∧ f e.2 ≠ a at hcross
    change f e.2 = a
    exact heq ▸ hcross.1
  · refine ⟨hadj, fun heq => hcross.1 ?_⟩
    change f e.1 ≠ a ∧ f e.2 = a at hcross
    change f e.1 = a
    exact heq.symm ▸ hcross.2

/-- On a finite-boundary one-ended graph, every finite-valued field with only finitely many
changing edges is eventually constant.  This is the finite-clock reconstruction mechanism. -/
theorem eventuallyConstant_of_finite_edgeVariation
    {α : Type*} [Fintype α] [Infinite V]
    {G : SimpleGraph V} (hG : FiniteBoundaryOneEnded G) (f : V → α)
    (hvariation : (edgeVariation G f).Finite) :
    EventuallyConstant f := by
  classical
  have hfiberBoundary : ∀ a : α, (edgeBoundary G {v | f v = a}).Finite :=
    fun a => hvariation.subset (edgeBoundary_fiber_subset_edgeVariation G f a)
  have hfiberDichotomy : ∀ a : α,
      {v | f v = a}.Finite ∨ {v | f v = a}ᶜ.Finite :=
    fun a => hG {v | f v = a} (hfiberBoundary a)
  by_contra hnot
  simp only [EventuallyConstant, not_exists] at hnot
  have hfiberFinite : ∀ a : α, {v | f v = a}.Finite := by
    intro a
    exact (hfiberDichotomy a).resolve_right (by
      intro hcofinite
      apply hnot a
      have hset : {v | f v = a}ᶜ = {v | f v ≠ a} := by
        ext v
        simp
      simpa only [hset] using hcofinite)
  have hunionFinite : (⋃ a : α, {v | f v = a}).Finite :=
    Set.finite_iUnion hfiberFinite
  have hcover : (⋃ a : α, {v | f v = a}) = (Set.univ : Set V) := by
    ext v
    simp
  rw [hcover] at hunionFinite
  exact Set.infinite_univ hunionFinite

/-- Additive oriented pair coherence.  For the finite clock `ZMod m`, this is the exponent of
`u(i) * conjugate (u(j))`. -/
def additiveEdgeCoherence {A : Type*} [AddGroup A]
    (u : V → A) (e : V × V) : A :=
  u e.1 - u e.2

/-- Ordered graph edges on which two additive coherence fields disagree. -/
def additiveEdgeDisagreement {A : Type*} [AddGroup A]
    (G : SimpleGraph V) (u v : V → A) : Set (V × V) :=
  {e | G.Adj e.1 e.2 ∧ additiveEdgeCoherence u e ≠ additiveEdgeCoherence v e}

/-- The finite-clock domain-wall identity: coherence disagreement is exactly variation of the
relative phase. -/
theorem additiveEdgeDisagreement_eq_edgeVariation
    {A : Type*} [AddCommGroup A]
    (G : SimpleGraph V) (u v : V → A) :
    additiveEdgeDisagreement G u v = edgeVariation G (fun x => u x - v x) := by
  ext e
  have heq :
      (u e.1 - u e.2 = v e.1 - v e.2) ↔
        (u e.1 - v e.1 = u e.2 - v e.2) :=
    sub_eq_sub_iff_sub_eq_sub
  change
    (G.Adj e.1 e.2 ∧ u e.1 - u e.2 ≠ v e.1 - v e.2) ↔
      (G.Adj e.1 e.2 ∧ u e.1 - v e.1 ≠ u e.2 - v e.2)
  exact and_congr_right fun _ => not_congr heq

/-- Finite-defect additive edge coherence on a finite clock determines the relative phase outside
a finite vertex set whenever the graph has the finite-boundary one-ended property. -/
theorem additiveEdgeTail_reconstruct_of_finiteBoundaryOneEnded
    {A : Type*} [AddCommGroup A] [Fintype A] [Infinite V]
    {G : SimpleGraph V} (hG : FiniteBoundaryOneEnded G) (u v : V → A)
    (hcoherence : (additiveEdgeDisagreement G u v).Finite) :
    EventuallyConstant (fun x => u x - v x) := by
  apply eventuallyConstant_of_finite_edgeVariation hG

/-!
# Conventional graph ends from finite-boundary coherence

For infinite locally finite preconnected graphs, the finite-boundary coherence condition is
exactly equivalent to the conventional inverse-system end type being subsingleton. The proof
constructs ends through arbitrary infinite complement components and uses finite pigeonhole
control of components after a finite edge defect.
-/

open Set

/-- Neighbor support of a finite vertex set. -/
def finiteNeighborSupport (G : SimpleGraph V) (K : Finset V) : Set V :=
  ⋃ k ∈ K, G.neighborSet k

theorem finiteNeighborSupport_finite (G : SimpleGraph V) [G.LocallyFinite]
    (K : Finset V) : (finiteNeighborSupport G K).Finite := by
  classical
  exact K.finite_toSet.biUnion fun k _ => Set.toFinite (G.neighborSet k)

/-- A component outside a finite vertex set has finite ordered edge boundary in a locally finite
graph. -/
theorem edgeBoundary_componentCompl_finite
    (G : SimpleGraph V) [G.LocallyFinite] (K : Finset V)
    (C : G.ComponentCompl K) :
    (edgeBoundary G (C : Set V)).Finite := by
  classical
  let N := finiteNeighborSupport G K
  have hN : N.Finite := finiteNeighborSupport_finite G K
  have hK : (K : Set V).Finite := K.finite_toSet
  have hsub : edgeBoundary G (C : Set V) ⊆
      (N ×ˢ (K : Set V)) ∪ ((K : Set V) ×ˢ N) := by
    intro e he
    rcases he with ⟨hadj, hcross | hcross⟩
    · have he₂K : e.2 ∈ K := by
        by_contra he₂K
        exact hcross.2 (C.mem_of_adj e.1 e.2 hcross.1 he₂K hadj)
      left
      refine ⟨?_, he₂K⟩
      exact Set.mem_iUnion₂.mpr ⟨e.2, he₂K, hadj.symm⟩
    · have he₁K : e.1 ∈ K := by
        by_contra he₁K
        exact hcross.1 (C.mem_of_adj e.2 e.1 hcross.2 he₁K hadj.symm)
      right
      refine ⟨he₁K, ?_⟩
      exact Set.mem_iUnion₂.mpr ⟨e.1, he₁K, hadj⟩
  exact ((hN.prod hK).union (hK.prod hN)).subset hsub

/-- The formal finite-boundary one-ended condition forces the conventional inverse-system end
type to have at most one element. -/
theorem subsingleton_end_of_finiteBoundaryOneEnded
    (G : SimpleGraph V) [G.LocallyFinite]
    (hG : FiniteBoundaryOneEnded G) :
    Subsingleton G.end := by
  constructor
  intro e₁ e₂
  apply Subtype.ext
  funext K
  by_contra hne
  let C₁ : G.ComponentCompl K.unop := e₁.val K
  let C₂ : G.ComponentCompl K.unop := e₂.val K
  have hC₁neC₂ : C₁ ≠ C₂ := by
    simpa only [C₁, C₂] using! hne
  have hC₁inf : (C₁ : Set V).Infinite := by
    simpa only [C₁] using! SimpleGraph.end_componentCompl_infinite G e₁ K
  have hC₂inf : (C₂ : Set V).Infinite := by
    simpa only [C₂] using! SimpleGraph.end_componentCompl_infinite G e₂ K
  have hdisjoint : Disjoint (C₁ : Set V) (C₂ : Set V) :=
    SimpleGraph.ComponentCompl.pairwise_disjoint hC₁neC₂
  have hC₂sub : (C₂ : Set V) ⊆ (C₁ : Set V)ᶜ := by
    intro x hx₂
    simp only [Set.mem_compl_iff]
    intro hx₁
    exact Set.disjoint_left.mp hdisjoint hx₁ hx₂
  rcases hG (C₁ : Set V) (edgeBoundary_componentCompl_finite G K.unop C₁) with
      hC₁finite | hC₁cofinite
  · exact hC₁inf hC₁finite
  · exact hC₂inf (hC₁cofinite.subset hC₂sub)

/-- Every infinite component outside a finite vertex set is the value of some conventional graph
end at that finite set. -/
theorem exists_end_through_infinite_component
    (G : SimpleGraph V) [Infinite V] [G.LocallyFinite] [Fact G.Preconnected]
    (K : (Finset V)ᵒᵖ) (C : G.componentComplFunctor.obj K)
    (hC : C.supp.Infinite) :
    ∃ e : G.end, e.val K = C := by
  classical
  let F := G.componentComplFunctor
  have hML : F.IsMittagLeffler := by
    apply F.isMittagLeffler_of_exists_finite_range
    intro j
    refine ⟨j, 𝟙 j, ?_⟩
    exact Set.toFinite (Set.range (F.map (𝟙 j)))
  letI : ∀ j, Nonempty (F.toEventualRanges.obj j) :=
    fun j => F.toEventualRanges_nonempty hML j
  have hsurj : ∀ ⦃i j⦄ (f : i ⟶ j),
      Function.Surjective (F.toEventualRanges.map f) :=
    fun _ _ f =>
      CategoryTheory.Functor.surjective_toEventualRanges F hML f
  have hCeventual : C ∈ F.eventualRange K :=
    (SimpleGraph.infinite_iff_in_eventualRange G C).mp hC
  let C' : F.toEventualRanges.obj K := ⟨C, hCeventual⟩
  obtain ⟨sec, hsec⟩ :=
    F.toEventualRanges.eval_section_surjective_of_surjective hsurj K C'
  let e : G.end := F.toEventualRangesSectionsEquiv sec
  refine ⟨e, ?_⟩
  exact congrArg Subtype.val hsec

/-- A two-level label realizing a prescribed vertex cut. -/
noncomputable def twoLevelLabel {A : Type*} [Zero A]
    (a : A) (S : Set V) (v : V) : A := by
  classical
  exact if v ∈ S then a else 0

theorem edgeVariation_twoLevelLabel
    {A : Type*} [Zero A] (G : SimpleGraph V) (S : Set V) (a : A) (ha : a ≠ 0) :
    edgeVariation G (twoLevelLabel a S) = edgeBoundary G S := by
  classical
  ext e
  by_cases h₁ : e.1 ∈ S <;> by_cases h₂ : e.2 ∈ S <;>
    simp [edgeVariation, edgeBoundary, twoLevelLabel, h₁, h₂, ha, ha.symm]

/-- **Finite-clock faithfulness criterion.**  For every nontrivial finite additive clock, the
finite-boundary one-ended property is exactly finite-defect reconstruction of relative phase up
to an eventually constant global clock value. -/
theorem finiteBoundaryOneEnded_iff_additiveEdgeTail_faithful
    {A : Type*} [AddCommGroup A] [Fintype A] [Nontrivial A] [Infinite V]
    (G : SimpleGraph V) :
    FiniteBoundaryOneEnded G ↔
      ∀ u v : V → A, (additiveEdgeDisagreement G u v).Finite →
        EventuallyConstant (fun x => u x - v x) := by
  constructor
  · intro hG u v hfinite
    exact additiveEdgeTail_reconstruct_of_finiteBoundaryOneEnded hG u v hfinite
  · intro hfaithful S hboundary
    classical
    obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := exists_ne (0 : A)
    let u : V → A := twoLevelLabel a S
    let v : V → A := fun _ => 0
    have hcoherence : (additiveEdgeDisagreement G u v).Finite := by
      rw [additiveEdgeDisagreement_eq_edgeVariation]
      have hrelative : (fun x => u x - v x) = u := by
        funext x
        simp [v]
      rw [hrelative]
      change (edgeVariation G (twoLevelLabel a S)).Finite
      rw [edgeVariation_twoLevelLabel G S a ha]
      exact hboundary
    obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := hfaithful u v hcoherence
    by_cases hc0 : c = 0
    · left
      have hset : {x | u x - v x ≠ c} = S := by
        ext x
        simp [u, v, twoLevelLabel, hc0, ha]
      simpa only [hset] using hc
    · right
      apply hc.subset
      intro x hx
      change x ∉ S at hx
      change u x - v x ≠ c
      simpa [u, v, twoLevelLabel, hx] using (Ne.symm hc0)

/-- Vertices incident to an ordered edge in `F`. -/
def edgeEndpointSupport {X : Type*} (F : Set (X × X)) : Set X :=
  Prod.fst '' F ∪ Prod.snd '' F

theorem edgeEndpointSupport_finite {X : Type*} {F : Set (X × X)} (hF : F.Finite) :
    (edgeEndpointSupport F).Finite :=
  (hF.image Prod.fst).union (hF.image Prod.snd)

/-- First-coordinate projection of the endpoints of an ordered edge family. -/
def edgeFirstCoordinateSupport {X Y : Type*} (F : Set ((X × Y) × (X × Y))) : Set X :=
  Prod.fst '' edgeEndpointSupport F

/-- Second-coordinate projection of the endpoints of an ordered edge family. -/
def edgeSecondCoordinateSupport {X Y : Type*} (F : Set ((X × Y) × (X × Y))) : Set Y :=
  Prod.snd '' edgeEndpointSupport F

theorem edgeFirstCoordinateSupport_finite {X Y : Type*}
    {F : Set ((X × Y) × (X × Y))} (hF : F.Finite) :
    (edgeFirstCoordinateSupport F).Finite :=
  (edgeEndpointSupport_finite hF).image Prod.fst

theorem edgeSecondCoordinateSupport_finite {X Y : Type*}
    {F : Set ((X × Y) × (X × Y))} (hF : F.Finite) :
    (edgeSecondCoordinateSupport F).Finite :=
  (edgeEndpointSupport_finite hF).image Prod.snd

theorem exists_not_mem_of_finite {X : Type*} [Infinite X]
    {S : Set X} (hS : S.Finite) : ∃ x, x ∉ S := by
  by_contra h
  simp only [not_exists, not_not] at h
  have hSuniv : S = Set.univ := Set.eq_univ_of_forall h
  rw [hSuniv] at hS
  exact Set.infinite_univ hS

/-- Boolean membership label of a set. -/
noncomputable def cutLabel {X : Type*} (S : Set X) (x : X) : Bool := by
  classical
  exact if x ∈ S then true else false

theorem cutLabel_eq_iff {X : Type*} (S : Set X) (x y : X) :
    cutLabel S x = cutLabel S y ↔ (x ∈ S ↔ y ∈ S) := by
  classical
  by_cases hx : x ∈ S <;> by_cases hy : y ∈ S <;>
    simp [cutLabel, hx, hy]

theorem cutLabel_adjInvariant_right_of_not_mem_firstSupport
    {W : Type*} {G : SimpleGraph V} {H : SimpleGraph W}
    (A : Set (V × W)) (g : V)
    (hg : g ∉ edgeFirstCoordinateSupport (edgeBoundary (G □ H) A)) :
    ∀ ⦃h₁ h₂⦄, H.Adj h₁ h₂ →
      cutLabel A (g, h₁) = cutLabel A (g, h₂) := by
  intro h₁ h₂ hadj
  rw [cutLabel_eq_iff]
  constructor
  · intro h₁A
    by_contra h₂A
    apply hg
    refine ⟨(g, h₁), ?_, rfl⟩
    apply Or.inl
    refine ⟨((g, h₁), (g, h₂)), ?_, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨SimpleGraph.boxProd_adj_right.mpr hadj, Or.inl ⟨h₁A, h₂A⟩⟩
  · intro h₂A
    by_contra h₁A
    apply hg
    refine ⟨(g, h₁), ?_, rfl⟩

/-- A Boolean orientation is projectively trivial exactly when its negative domain is finite or

theorem booleanProjectiveFiniteTailClass_eq_allPositive_iff
    (ε : V → Bool) :
    booleanProjectiveFiniteTailClass ε =
        booleanProjectiveFiniteTailClass (fun _ => false) ↔
      {v | ε v = true}.Finite ∨ ({v | ε v = true}ᶜ).Finite := by
  constructor
  · intro h
    have heq : BooleanProjectiveFiniteEquivalent ε (fun _ => false) := Quotient.exact h
    rcases heq with hdiff | hagree
    · left
      have hset : {v | ε v ≠ false} = {v | ε v = true} := by
        ext v
        cases ε v <;> simp
      simpa only [hset] using hdiff
    · right
      have hset : {v | ε v = false} = {v | ε v = true}ᶜ := by
        ext v
        cases ε v <;> simp
      simpa only [hset] using hagree
  · rintro (hfinite | hcofinite)
    · apply Quotient.sound
      left
      have hset : {v | ε v ≠ false} = {v | ε v = true} := by
        ext v
        cases ε v <;> simp
      simpa only [hset] using hfinite
    · apply Quotient.sound
      right
      have hset : {v | ε v = false} = {v | ε v = true}ᶜ := by
        ext v
        cases ε v <;> simp
      simpa only [hset] using hcofinite

  rw [← finiteBoundaryEndClopen_empty G,
    finiteBoundaryEndClopen_eq_iff_symmDiff_finite]

  have hset : (A.1) ∆ (∅ : Set V) = A.1 := by
    ext v
    simp [Set.mem_symmDiff]
  rw [hset]

    finiteBoundaryEndClopen G A = ⊤ ↔ ((A.1)ᶜ).Finite := by
  rw [← finiteBoundaryEndClopen_univ G,
    finiteBoundaryEndClopen_eq_iff_symmDiff_finite]
  change ((A.1) ∆ (Set.univ : Set V)).Finite ↔ ((A.1)ᶜ).Finite
  have hset : (A.1) ∆ (Set.univ : Set V) = (A.1)ᶜ := by
    ext v
    simp [Set.mem_symmDiff]
  rw [hset]

/-!
# Canonical finite-defect coherence quotient

For a locally finite graph, finite vertex changes induce only finite edge defects, so Boolean pair
coherence descends from projective vertex tails to an edge-coherence quotient. The descended map
is injective exactly when every finite-boundary vertex set is finite or cofinite.
-/

namespace GaloisForLFunctions.HTGeometry

open Set

universe u
variable {V : Type u}

theorem edgeBoundary_compl (G : SimpleGraph V) (A : Set V) :
    edgeBoundary G Aᶜ = edgeBoundary G A := by
  ext e
  simp only [edgeBoundary, Set.mem_setOf_eq, Set.mem_compl_iff]
  tauto

theorem edgeBoundary_finite_of_set_finite
    (G : SimpleGraph V) [G.LocallyFinite] {A : Set V} (hA : A.Finite) :
    (edgeBoundary G A).Finite := by
  classical
  let N : Set V := ⋃ v ∈ A, G.neighborSet v
  have hN : N.Finite := hA.biUnion fun v _ => Set.toFinite (G.neighborSet v)
  have hsub : edgeBoundary G A ⊆ (A ×ˢ N) ∪ (N ×ˢ A) := by
    intro e he
    rcases he with ⟨hadj, hcross | hcross⟩
    · left
      refine ⟨hcross.1, ?_⟩
      exact Set.mem_iUnion₂.mpr ⟨e.1, hcross.1, hadj⟩
    · right
      refine ⟨?_, hcross.2⟩
      exact Set.mem_iUnion₂.mpr ⟨e.2, hcross.2, hadj.symm⟩
  exact ((hA.prod hN).union (hN.prod hA)).subset hsub

theorem BooleanProjectiveFiniteEquivalent.refl (ε : V → Bool) :
    BooleanProjectiveFiniteEquivalent ε ε := by
  left
  have hset : {v | ε v ≠ ε v} = (∅ : Set V) := by simp
  rw [hset]
  exact Set.finite_empty

theorem BooleanProjectiveFiniteEquivalent.symm {ε δ : V → Bool}
    (h : BooleanProjectiveFiniteEquivalent ε δ) :
    BooleanProjectiveFiniteEquivalent δ ε := by
  rcases h with h | h
  · left
    have hset : {v | δ v ≠ ε v} = {v | ε v ≠ δ v} := by
      ext v
      simp [ne_comm]
    simpa only [hset] using h
  · right
    have hset : {v | δ v = ε v} = {v | ε v = δ v} := by
      ext v
      simp [eq_comm]
    simpa only [hset] using h

theorem BooleanProjectiveFiniteEquivalent.trans {ε δ η : V → Bool}
    (hεδ : BooleanProjectiveFiniteEquivalent ε δ)
    (hδη : BooleanProjectiveFiniteEquivalent δ η) :
    BooleanProjectiveFiniteEquivalent ε η := by
  rcases hεδ with hεδ | hεδ <;> rcases hδη with hδη | hδη
  · left
    apply (hεδ.union hδη).subset
    intro v hv
    simp only [Set.mem_union, Set.mem_setOf_eq] at hv ⊢
    by_cases hpoint : ε v = δ v
    · exact Or.inr fun hδηpoint => hv (hpoint.trans hδηpoint)
    · exact Or.inl hpoint
  · right
    apply (hεδ.union hδη).subset
    intro v hv
    simp only [Set.mem_union, Set.mem_setOf_eq] at hv ⊢
    by_cases hpoint : ε v = δ v
    · exact Or.inr (hpoint.symm.trans hv)
    · exact Or.inl hpoint
  · right
    apply (hεδ.union hδη).subset
    intro v hv
    simp only [Set.mem_union, Set.mem_setOf_eq] at hv ⊢
    by_cases hpoint : δ v = η v
    · exact Or.inl (hv.trans hpoint.symm)
    · exact Or.inr hpoint
  · left
    apply (hεδ.union hδη).subset
    intro v hv
    simp only [Set.mem_union, Set.mem_setOf_eq] at hv ⊢
    by_cases hpoint₁ : ε v = δ v
    · exact Or.inl hpoint₁
    · by_cases hpoint₂ : δ v = η v
      · exact Or.inr hpoint₂
      · exfalso
        apply hv
        cases hε : ε v <;> cases hδ : δ v <;> cases hη : η v <;> simp_all

  r := BooleanProjectiveFiniteEquivalent
  iseqv := ⟨BooleanProjectiveFiniteEquivalent.refl,

    BooleanProjectiveFiniteEquivalent.trans⟩

theorem BooleanEdgeTailEquivalent.trans {G : SimpleGraph V} {ε δ η : V → Bool}
    (hεδ : BooleanEdgeTailEquivalent G ε δ)
    (hδη : BooleanEdgeTailEquivalent G δ η) :
